source.method: Compile each stored standard graph and a one-call current legacy descriptor graph, then execute both against the same deterministic host harness and compare result/error/diagnostic tuples.
source.coverage: The 16 stored composition graphs only; this is a bounded behavior audit, not a claim about all standard routes.

notes: The legacy adapter canonicalizes every returned cell; the public composition filters in caller order and reconstructs each retained cell from pure x/y coordinates.

limitations: The host harness models live-piece query ordering, ally/enemy ownership, map tiles, and the normal target-policy branch; it does not replace the production host or prove adventure-specific policy.

A mismatch is retained with its current/legacy tuple and explicit classification. The bounded mismatches here are approved invalid-reference, empty-choice, or host invalid-dependency boundaries; none is counted as an authoring gap.
The route catalog still has 55 standard-public-composition rows without this bounded execution proof; they remain unverified in the route report.
Retired captured queue/remove/summon IDs are excluded from the active route set after migration. Any remaining true gap is read from the current route report rather than assumed by this proof.
